requirements.label: 128 Total Credits
requirements.hint: The BFA requires 128 credits in total: 66 to 72 studio credits and 56 to 62 non-studio credits.

requirements.label: Studio credits (66)
requirements.hint: At least 66 of the 128 credits must be studio courses. Matched by the school's studio designation plus Stamps study abroad; up to 6 studio credits from other U-M schools may apply through the adjust control.

requirements.label: Non-studio credits (56)
requirements.hint: At least 56 of the 128 credits must be non-studio coursework (Stamps academic courses and courses across U-M).

requirements.label: Foundation studios (7 courses)
requirements.hint: ARTDES 100 and 105 (Drawing 1 & 2), 115 (2D), 120 (3D), 125 (4D), 130 (Creative Process Strategies), and 220 (Second Year Studio).

requirements.label: ARTDES 150 & 151: Art & Design in Context / History
requirements.hint: The two required first-year academic courses.

requirements.label: Stamps Lecture Series (8 credits)
requirements.hint: ARTDES 160, 1 credit per term for 8 terms. Each completed term counts; a planned term registers once, so log each term as taken when it finishes.

requirements.label: ARTDES 399: Writing in Art and Design
requirements.hint: The BFA's required writing course, normally taken in the third year.

requirements.label: Elective studios (45 credits)
requirements.hint: A minimum of fifteen elective studios. Up to two studio mini-courses (3 credits total) and up to 6 credits of studio work from other U-M schools or approved study abroad may count; apply those through the adjust control.

requirements.label: 200-level elective studios (12 credits)
requirements.hint: Four elective studios at the 200 level.

requirements.label: 300-level elective studios (12 credits)
requirements.hint: Four elective studios at the 300 level.

requirements.label: Engagement studio
requirements.hint: One elective studio must carry the Engagement designation (the ARTDES 310-319 block, plus other designated studios).

requirements.label: 400-level studios or Integrative Project
requirements.hint: Either three 400-level elective studios (9 credits) or the two-semester senior Integrative Project (ARTDES 498 in fall, ARTDES 499 in winter, 9 credits).

requirements.label: 400-level elective studios option (9 credits)
requirements.hint: Three elective studios at the 400 level.

requirements.label: Integrative Project option (9 credits)
requirements.hint: ARTDES 498 and 499, the two-semester senior studio culminating in a senior project.

requirements.label: First-year writing
requirements.hint: One course fulfilling the First-Year Writing Requirement.

requirements.label: Social science (3 credits)
requirements.hint: At least 3 credits of social science coursework.

requirements.label: Natural science (3 credits)
requirements.hint: At least 3 credits of natural science coursework.

requirements.label: Analytical reasoning (3 credits)
requirements.hint: At least 3 credits carrying the MSA or QR distribution marks.

requirements.label: Environmental studies (3 credits)
requirements.hint: At least 3 credits of environmental studies. Matched to the Program in the Environment (ENVIRON) subject; use the adjust control for an environment course from another department.

requirements.label: Race and ethnicity (3 credits)
requirements.hint: At least 3 credits carrying the Race & Ethnicity mark. One course may satisfy this alongside another distribution area.

requirements.label: Art/design history, theory, criticism (6 credits)
requirements.hint: 6 to 8 credits of art or design history, theory, or criticism beyond ARTDES 151. Matched to History of Art courses and Stamps HTC-designated courses.

requirements.label: Sophomore Review
requirements.hint: Still building a way to track this milestone: present your work to date to a faculty committee in the winter of sophomore year (no credit, participation mandatory). Mark it done with the adjust control once completed.
